item.title: UAMS Names Claudia Barone to Lead College of Nursing Linda Hodges Retiring After 17 years as Dean
item.content:encoded:
UAMS today named Claudia Barone the new dean.

The outgoing dean is described as a transformative leader.
item.excerpt:encoded: Claudia Barone named dean; Linda Hodges retiring.
